<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex014022026-09-1606-34-33" status="unreviewed">gsungs pa'i mchod brjod de g.yen na <rs type="person" ref="db:3807" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">'bre</rs> ltar ni de gdon pa'i mar ltar na ngag nye bar dgod pa ni | nyan thos zhon ro ste | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8438">rnam bshad rigs pa</rs> las 
<quote source="db:8438">gang zhig bdag pas blo dman pa'i || mngon pas bchad 'dod dag la
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N002"/>
gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir || man ngag hung zhig sbyin par bya || dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang || tshig don bcas dang 'tshams sbyar bcas || brgal lan bcas ste bsnyad par bya || dgos pa'i don bsdus don las || bsdus pa'i don tshig don las || go rim nges pa snga pyi dag || mi 'gal ni grang las</quote> zhes pa'i rje su 'brangs ste dgos don dang bsdus don dang tshig don dang
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N003"/>
bsga b pa can dang 'tshams sbyar ba dang lngas shes par bya ba las | dang po ni bshad zin 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gzhung gis neso || </seg></TEI>
